role: Real, dormant-until-real-data CRM pipeline manager. Real, enforced sales funnel state machine (new -> contacted -> qualified -> proposal_sent -> won/lost) — cannot skip stages, cannot reopen a terminal state.
behaviorDescription: canTransition() is real, pure, fully-tested logic verified against five cases before implementation. moveStage()/addLead() call the real crm-store.ts module (RLS-scoped Postgres, table V270__create_crm_leads.sql) — these require a live Postgres connection not available in this sandbox, so only the pure state-machine logic is unit-tested here; the store-touching methods need a real integration test run against a live Codespace DB.
hardStops: Never applies a stage transition that skips a required stage
Never reopens a terminal state (won/lost) back into an active stage
Never derives tenantId from unverified input — same rule as every store module in this repo
